sloka: अति खिन्नः शरीरे अस्मिन् प्राणो लक्ष्मण विद्यते ।तथा स्वर विहीनो अयम् विक्लवम् समुदीक्षते ॥३-६८-३॥
transliteration: ati khinnaḥ śarīre asmin prāṇo lakṣmaṇa vidyate ।tathā svara vihīno ayam viklavam samudīkṣate ॥3-68-3॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, it appears he is frightened and is experiencing excruciating pain in the body. His voice sounds faint, too.
